steps.title: See today's market mood at a glance
steps.narration: The Dashboard opens with the Market Regime card, showing today's overall market read at a glance.
steps.point_out: The colored regime badge and score near the top of the page.

steps.title: See what's driving that reading
steps.narration: Expanding the breakdown shows exactly which signals feed into the regime score, so nothing is a black box.
steps.point_out: Each named component (index trend, breadth, new highs, the volatility gate) with its own contribution.

steps.title: Jump straight to the proof
steps.narration: A direct link connects the regime card to the evidence ledger, so you can check what's actually been proven before trusting a signal.
steps.point_out: The evidence ledger opens, showing each tracked idea with its honest pass/fail verdict.

target.name: See evidence proven in this regime →

steps.title: Browse the ranked stock leaderboard
steps.narration: The stock leaderboard ranks every name by leadership, entry quality, and risk, with every single score labeled by whether it's backed by proof.
steps.point_out: Hundreds of ranked rows, each score tagged 'Not yet proven' until a signal earns certified evidence.

steps.title: Drill into one stock
steps.narration: Opening a single stock shows the same three scores in more detail, alongside its full price history.
steps.point_out: AAPL's Leadership, Entry Quality, and Risk scores, each still honestly marked as unproven.

steps.title: Stretch the chart back through decades
steps.narration: Switching to full history stretches the chart back through decades of real trading data, with no shortcuts or gaps.
steps.point_out: The price chart extends much further back while staying smooth and continuous.

steps.title: Visit the Data Manager
steps.narration: The Data Manager page is home to the heaviest job in the app: rebuilding every score across the full history for every stock. This iteration made that job dependable, so it can now run start to finish, twice in a row, without taking the app down.
steps.point_out: Dataset coverage, storage footprint, and job progress panels, all showing real numbers for the full universe.
